The complete corresponding source, including the exact submodule revisions and
build scripts, is available without charge at:

https://github.com/optiscaler/OptiScaler/tree/v0.9.4

Exact upstream commit:
7534ad00bf9e590eedb99e8dd9fd8c89dae3654f

To obtain a machine-readable local copy:

git clone --branch v0.9.4 --recurse-submodules \
  https://github.com/optiscaler/OptiScaler.git

The embedded binary has not been modified by this Minecraft mod. OptiScaler and
the Minecraft mod remain separate works collected in one distribution archive.
The OptiScaler license applies to OptiScaler; the license of each additional
runtime library is included beside that library under runtime/Licenses.
